issue: The in-figure explanatory text states 'tokens per submitted request grow ~2.5× under no prefix reuse (mix 68/25/5/2%, Table 19-1: 2.52x)'. Independent recomputation from the stated mix and the book's own billable-token arithmetic (p. 362: Σ over turns of the full accumulated context each turn sends) does not reproduce 2.52×.
evidence: Billable input tokens per the book's definition: T=0: 9,200; T=1: 19,265; T=2: 30,195; T=3: 41,990 (the T=3 value 41,990 is confirmed on p. 362). Weighted average with mix 68/25/5/2% = 0.68×9,200 + 0.25×19,265 + 0.05×30,195 + 0.02×41,990 = 13,422. Ratio to single-shot 9,200 = 1.46×, not 2.52×. If the mix is reinterpreted as agentic-only (T=1/2/3/4 with 68/25/5/2%), the ratio is ~2.59× — closer but still not 2.52×. The figure cross-references Table 19-1 for the 2.52× value; Table 19-1 was not in this batch and is NOT VERIFIED.
acceptance_test: Open Table 19-1, confirm the mix, the billable-token definition used, and the 2.52× computation. If the table uses a different definition (e.g., includes output tokens, or the mix is agentic-only) than the figure's parenthetical implies, reconcile the figure text with the table's definition. If the table's 2.52× is correct under its own stated definition, update the figure's parenthetical to match or add a one-clause clarifier.
